name: Bag fee line
description: Standard ancillary bag-fee line item — one entry per chargeable bag. Pair with an iterator over bag selections to emit one of these per bag.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Always "BAG" — distinguishes from other ancillary types.

fields.name: code
fields.description: IATA SSR / ATPCO sub-code (e.g. EXTRA_BAG_1, OVERWEIGHT).

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Charge in pointOfSale currency, post-tax unless taxIncluded=false.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 — should match the rest of the offer.

fields.name: paxId
fields.description: Optional — links the bag fee to a specific passenger.
